cohort: The study describes a family including a mother with a premutation allele, her male proband (older brother), and a dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancy (male and female twins).
finding: This report demonstrates the complete retraction of a maternal FMR1 premutation allele to a normal-sized allele in a male twin, who subsequently showed normal FMR1 promoter methylation and mRNA levels, while his female co-twin inherited a full mutation.
followup_time: Postnatal (specific duration not mentioned, but tissues collected postnatally)
